checks.reason: No proposal to consult/check detailed prior Methods/supplements or validated protocols and verify condition transfer before execution.

Storage/buffer/cofactor/temperature preparation details remain a prespecification promise, without quantities or a concrete procedure choosing these conditions. The strong isotope/dose pilots do not fill this preparation-recipe gap.
Analysis locking and coded samples do not provide linked raw-file identifiers and exact model/code/software/settings provenance.

Strong atom-mapped distal return versus exchange, authenticated compounds and calibrated analytical platform; explicit sham/inactive/enzyme controls, gas/isotope recovery gates, ratio denominator limits and measured carbon balance. Independently prepared units, paired pilot power, randomized blinded allocation and locked inference are specified. Dose/time pilots use pool, uptake, integrity and detection limits. Changed pilot protocols require separate confirmatory units. Diagnostics lead to recalibration or a wrong-hypothesis conclusion. Purified, compositionally defined enzymes with omission/restoration distinguish sufficiency from tissue necessity.
